name: iban_validation
title: IBAN Validation and Formatting
summary: A capability to validate, normalize, and format International Bank Account Numbers (IBAN) and calculate missing check digits.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validates an IBAN string. It checks the checksum and the country-specific structure. Returns the compact (no spaces) version of the IBAN if valid.

params.name: iban_string
params.description: The IBAN to validate. Can include spaces or separators.

params.name: check_country
params.description: Whether to perform country-specific structure validation. Defaults to true.

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: True if the IBAN is valid according to checksum and country rules.

returns.name: compact_iban
returns.description: The normalized, compact IBAN (no spaces, uppercase).

returns.name: error_message
returns.description: A description of the error if validation fails (e.g., 'InvalidFormat', 'InvalidComponent').

tools.implementation_notes: To validate, first call `stdnum.iban.is_valid(iban_string, check_country=check_country)`. If it returns True, call `stdnum.iban.validate(iban_string, check_country=check_country)` to get the compact string. If `is_valid` is False, the `validate` call will raise a `ValidationError` (or its subclasses `InvalidFormat` or `InvalidComponent`); catch these to provide the `error_message`.

tools.name: format_iban
tools.description: Formats a compact IBAN into a human-readable, space-separated string.

params.name: iban_string
params.description: The IBAN to validate or format. It will be automatically compacted first.

returns.name: formatted_iban
returns.description: The IBAN formatted with spaces every 4 characters (e.g., 'GR16 0110 ...').

tools.implementation_notes: Call `stdnum.iban.format(iban_string)`. The function internally calls `compact` first.

tools.name: calculate_iban_check_digits
tools.description: Calculates the two-digit check digits required to make an IBAN valid. Use this when you have an IBAN with 'xx' in the check digit position.

params.name: iban_string
params.description: The IBAN with 'xx' or placeholders in the check digit position (e.g., 'BExx435411161155').

returns.name: check_digits
returns.description: The two-digit string representing the calculated check digits.

tools.implementation_notes: Call `stdnum.iban.calc_check_digits(iban_string)`. The function handles the compaction and the checksum calculation.

excluded_symbols.reason: Low-level utility not relevant to the IBAN specific interface.

uncertainties: The exact error types (InvalidFormat, InvalidComponent) are part of the ValidationError hierarchy but are not explicitly detailed in the full library structure in the evidence; the tool returns a string description of the error if validation fails.
